All 9 probes re-executed one at a time via rdm story mutation-probe. Clauses: (1) a DI declares depends_on -- sdd reader -> [] KILLED; (2) the pin covers the text of every transitive upstream input -- dropping the transitive pending.extend KILLED, pinned_text returning own text KILLED, current_hashes hashing raw text KILLED; (2b) at the default MODULE scope too -- using pinned_text only when scope == SCOPE_FUNCTION in current_hashes now KILLED (was SURVIVED); (3) unrelated inputs stay current, downstream changes do not travel upstream -- upstream_closure returning every id KILLED; (4) tolerating cycles -- removing the `dep in seen` guard KILLED under the 5s termination guard; removing `dep == di_id` SURVIVED again, a documented equivalent mutant (the seen-set still terminates, and an input's own text in its own pin changes no staleness outcome); (5) design gate warns on an undeclared dependency -- not subtracting declared ids KILLED. The module-scope check uses tests_dir=None, so no test sources are involved; module/function hashing of real sources is DI-28's concern and covered there. All clauses covered.
